description: Jev-Style guard: checks tool calls with the local Jev-Style server before they run.

hooks.command: J=$(command -v jev-style || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/jev-style"); "$J" guard || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Jev-Style guard could not start (is the jev-style CLI installed?); asking instead."}}'
